name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
September 8, 2009
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Waite
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of certificates of appreciation to sponsors of 3rd Annual Golf Classic and Mayor’s Cup and presentation of check.
Presentation by Caporicci & Larson, auditors, to discuss the audit process.
Cypress Street reservoir update provided by IEC, construction project manager.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: June 10 and July 6
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting July 2009 Treasury and Investment Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report submitting resolution confirming the factors used for calculating the annual appropriation limit for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2009 and ending June 30, 2010. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting change orders to SSC Construction contract and Tetra Tech construction engineering services contract for Cypress Street reservoir. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report recommending adoption of ordinance granting a franchise to construct and use an oil pipeline to ConocoPhillips Pipeline Co. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report submitting resolution supporting legislation to establish a minimum distance requirement for licensed and unlicensed sober living facilities. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending that the city approve a memorandum of participation and authorization to proceed with Environmental Innovation Group (EIG) for consulting services for projects and programs to reduce energy use. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report recommending that the city become a Points of Dispensing partner with Los Angeles County to assist with the mass H1N1 vaccination program. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
n.
Report recommending approval of municipal law enforcement services agreement renewal for September 1, 2009 to June 30, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
HOTELS AND MOTOR INNS Public hearing on Zone Text Amendment No 2009-02, amending Section 11.1.45.05 to allow hotels and motor inns as a conditionally permitted use in the C-G zone.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtr Sugano.
7.
CITIZENS OPTION FOR PUBLIC SAFETY Public hearing to consider requests submitted by Sheriff’s Department for funding of front line municipal police services in accordance with provisions of AB 3229 - Citizens Option for Public Safety (COPS).
Presented by Comm Svcs Drtr McPherron.
8.
SIDEWALK/OUTDOOR SALES Discussion and possible action on a request from Councilmember Blackwood regarding temporary sidewalk/outdoor sales.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtr Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
